Overview

A culturally resonant identity for Kitab Utsav.

We partnered with Rajkamal Prakashan, one of India's most influential Hindi publishing houses, to develop the visual identity and communication ecosystem for Kitab Utsav, its annual book festival. The project involved creating a distinctive and culturally resonant brand experience that celebrated literature, ideas, and community engagement across multiple touchpoints.

Our scope covered event branding, print collateral, digital assets, and social media communication, ensuring a cohesive festival presence from launch to execution.

Introduction

A storied publisher of Hindi literature.

Rajkamal Prakashan is an esteemed publishing house dedicated to promoting literature and educational content. With a rich history and a commitment to quality, Rajkamal Prakashan sought to enhance their brand presence and streamline their operations through a series of strategic initiatives.

The Objective

Strengthen the brand, sharpen the operations.

Studio 1947 was engaged to provide a comprehensive suite of services aimed at strengthening Rajkamal Prakashan's brand identity and improving their operational efficiency. This included brand design, marketing collateral, and the development of an ERP dashboard for managing market sales.

Our Process

From heritage to a working sales tool.

01

Brand Design

We refined Rajkamal Prakashan's visual identity so it reflected their heritage and commitment to literary excellence — logo design, colour schemes, and typography that resonated with their audience.

02

Marketing Collateral

Our team designed a series of social media posters and advertisements that highlighted key publications and promotional campaigns, crafted to engage readers and drive sales.

03

ERP Dashboard Development

To streamline sales and operations, we built a custom ERP dashboard giving real-time insight into market sales, inventory management, and distribution logistics for more informed decisions.

The Result

Modern, timeless, and measurable.

The collaboration with Rajkamal Prakashan yielded significant results across brand, marketing, and operations.

  • 01Enhanced brand identity — a modern yet timeless appeal that strengthened their position in the competitive publishing industry.
  • 02Effective marketing campaigns — social media posters and advertisements that increased engagement and sales, reaching a broader audience of readers.
  • 03Operational excellence — an ERP dashboard that transformed sales management with real-time data and analytics.

Client Impact

Through our partnership, Rajkamal Prakashan achieved:

  • 01A cohesive and compelling brand identity that resonates with their audience.
  • 02Increased visibility and engagement through targeted marketing efforts.
  • 03Streamlined operations and improved sales management with the new ERP dashboard.

Why Studio 1947?

Creative design meets practical technology.

Studio 1947 is committed to delivering holistic solutions that address both branding and operational challenges. Our work with Rajkamal Prakashan showcases our ability to integrate creative design with practical technology, helping clients achieve their strategic goals and enhance their market presence.
